tierReason.text: Linear's OAuth docs describe a fully self-serve app-creation flow with no review, security assessment, or partner requirement of any kind.
tierReason.label: tested
tierReason.testNote: Fetched https://linear.app/developers/oauth-2-0-authentication on 2026-10-25; the required terms were present.

scopeForks.text: Submitting to Linear's optional Integration Directory (for public discoverability) isn't a technical review - Linear says it accepts integrations useful to the community and built by formal companies, generally turning away scripts and hobbyist apps. This doesn't block using your OAuth app directly; it only affects whether it's listed in the directory.
scopeForks.label: tested
scopeForks.testNote: Fetched https://linear.app/developers/integration-directory on 2026-10-25; the required terms were present.

claim.text: Composio offers a managed OAuth app for Linear by default, so a developer can skip registering their own.
claim.label: sourced

whatYouLose.text: On a managed app, the consent screen shows the platform's name and brand instead of yours, and scopes/rate limits are typically fixed rather than something you control.
whatYouLose.label: uncertain

whenToSwitch.text: Switch to your own Linear OAuth app once you need your own branding, specific scopes, or your own rate limits.
whenToSwitch.label: sourced

flow.text: A developer creates an OAuth2 application, chooses scopes, and users authorize it through Linear's standard OAuth flow; adding actor=app lets the app perform mutations itself instead of the authorizing user.
flow.label: tested
flow.testNote: Fetched https://linear.app/developers/oauth-2-0-authentication on 2026-10-25; the required terms were present.

appTypes.text: By default, API actions are attributed to the authenticating user; actor=app switches attribution to the app itself, intended for agents and service accounts.
appTypes.label: tested
appTypes.testNote: Fetched https://linear.app/developers/oauth-actor-authorization on 2026-10-25; the required terms were present.

tokenNotes.text: Access tokens expire after 24 hours and must be refreshed; a refresh has a 30-minute grace period to retry on a network error.
tokenNotes.label: tested

steps.title: Create a new OAuth2 application and set redirect URIs
steps.detail: Under Settings > API > OAuth applications, in a dedicated workspace if possible.

steps.title: Choose your scopes
steps.detail: Start with read, write, issues:create, or comments:create; avoid admin unless truly necessary.
